title: Camp Wightman

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Campers are welcomed to a time and place away. They step out of their comfort zones and away from their electronics to experience life in a new and powerful way. Lodging is in cabins based on the age of the campers. This fun, interactive experience helps campers with self confidence and enables them to experience God’s creation firsthand. Enjoy boating, swimming, art, nature, archery, campfires, smores and so much more! Our summer camp weeks run for ages 6 thru 16, with programs designed to meet kids where they are.
